name: isoutlier_moving
expr: mm = isoutlier(x,'movmedian',3); smm = sum(double(mm)); mm4 = double(mm(4)); maa = isoutlier(x,'movmean',3); smaa = sum(double(maa)); ma1 = isoutlier(x,'movmean',3,'ThresholdFactor',1); ma1d = double(ma1(4)); mb = isoutlier(x,'movmedian',[1 1]); eqb = double(isequal(mm,mb)); m4 = isoutlier(x,'movmedian',4); m4d = double(m4(4)); my = isoutlier(y,'movmedian',5); smy = sum(double(my)); Mm = isoutlier(M,'movmedian',3); sMm = sum(double(Mm(:)));
comment: Sig: m = isoutlier(A,'movmedian'|'movmean',window[,'ThresholdFactor',tf]). DEEP-PROBE 2026-06: added moving-window detection (separate spec from isoutlier.json to keep each expr under numkit's long-line parser limit). Window: scalar k -> odd +/-(k-1)/2, even k/2 back & k/2-1 fwd; or [back fwd]; truncated at ends; NaN-excluded. Per element, outlier iff |x_i - center| > tf*scale over the local window: movmedian center=local median, scale=1.4826*localMAD (smm=1, mm4=1 flags the lone 100); movmean center=local mean, scale=local sample std (smaa=0 at default tf=3; ma1d=1 once tf=1). [1 1]==scalar 3 (eqb=1); even k=4 also flags x(4) (m4d=1). Sliding median catches two separated anomalies (smy=2) and runs per-column on matrices (sMm=2). Bit-identical MATLAB R2025b.
